conditions.sameCount: Independent random pools with exact same Rare count.
conditions.differentCount: B deck is constructed from A deck by replacing only (B count − A count) Normal cards with new Rare identities; the common cards are identical.
conditions.duplicatePolicy: No duplicates within a pool; identities are sampled broadly and Rare identities are randomized. This avoids any single repeated card dominating.

formationAI: Five battle cards are selected independently for each 15-card pool by a noisy battle-value heuristic using HP, average dice, passive count, and trigger count. Noise permits both Rare battle and Rare support roles; placement rates are measured, not prescribed.
limits: All battle resolution, card effects, support use, RPS and dice outcomes use the existing BattleEngine and card data.
Formation choice is a simulation heuristic, not a player-selected optimal lineup; card values are not modified.
KO successors follow the game engine fixed cyclic order.
Browser rendering/input timing is not simulated.
